checks.name: Fluid/serverless-incompatible patterns beyond SPEC-02 scope
checks.expected: None found, or listed here if found
checks.actual: Searched app/, lib/, components/, middleware.ts, next.config.ts for: fs writes (fs.writeFile/appendFile/mkdir/createWriteStream) -- none found. setInterval/setTimeout -- found only in components/minori/MinoriWorkbench.tsx:67, components/arc/ReplayPlayer.tsx:123/180, components/layout/Navbar.tsx:85/88, app/blog/[slug]/BlogPostClient.tsx:41 -- all inside files marked 'use client' (browser-side timers, not server/serverless concerns). Hardcoded localhost/127.0.0.1/:5000 references outside package.json scripts -- none found in app/lib/components/middleware/next.config. checks.name: Dead/unused session-store dependencies (memorystore, connect-pg-simple)
checks.expected: Not called out in SPEC-02; flag if found unused
checks.actual: package.json lists memorystore@^1.6.8 and connect-pg-simple@^10.0.0 as dependencies, but grep across all .ts/.tsx files under the repo (excluding node_modules) found zero imports of either package. Auth/session actually uses iron-session (stateless, cookie-based) via lib/session.ts, which is serverless-safe. These two packages appear to be legacy Express-session leftovers with no code path reachable at runtime -- not a Vercel behavior risk since unused, but worth noting as dead weight / potential confusion. Not in SPEC-02's M1-M4 file list, so left unchanged per 'change only what's listed' rule; flagging as a minor finding for the advisor, not a blocker.
